rites.name: Thernaldock
rites.text: Thernaldock is the concept of the first sounding that gave Vesiathith its roots, a resonance held in the Singing before any dated Record was kept. In the Age of Strangers it was invoked by outsiders who anchored their ships to its tone and traded the pitch of their own songs for passage.

rites.name: Ilokasaruta
rites.text: Ilokasaruta is the concept of a binding oath made between the first sovereign and the living groves during the Sundering, when broken worlds drifted apart. It is remembered as the force that turned fractured soil into the first growing kingdoms and kept the Pact from dissolving.

rites.name: Pelustordon
rites.text: Pelustordon is a concept in Vesiathith that took shape during the Fall, when the sundered worlds drifted apart and the Pact was sworn over their broken shards. It is remembered as the principle that a bond, once cut by landfall, can still be carried as a tether across the void. Scholars of the Age of Sundering treat it as the quiet thread holding the Pact together.

rites.name: Graktoth
rites.text: Graktoth is a concept in Vesiathith, a figure of the Walled Age who stood at the first crossings and held the walls of the growing kingdoms. Its name is remembered in the orders that grew up around the groves and the churches of that age.

rites.name: Vesyustora
rites.text: Vesyustora is a ravenous hunger-sovereign of the Vesiathith dominion, a being whose drive to devour vital essence drew whole worlds into its withering gravity. Those who speak its name do so in whispers, calling it the Starving Crown. Its appetite is said to outlast the dying suns it leaves behind.

rites.name: Thavsizeth
rites.text: Thavsizeth is a dimming ember-mind that once guided wandering seekers through the drifting ashfields of Vesiathith, teaching them to hear the slow hum beneath dying suns. In its later age it quietly steered those students toward a doctrine of deliberate ruin, weaving rumours and gifts so that its chosen pupils would carry its ideas outward.

rites.name: Thathora
rites.text: Thathora is a concept of a shadow-hunter whose existence is hidden from the powers that rule Vesiathith, a figure trained in the cold arts of dread to track down the last sparks of an ancient order. In the stellar era this name is whispered among dying suns as a catalyst that ignites defiance across scattered worlds.

rites.name: Veseizeth
rites.text: Veseizeth is a tether-lattice of compressed graviton knots, fitted to the spine-ribs of Vesiathith's hunter-vessels, that snaps wandering ships from their folded passages into real space. Its pull is tuned to the ship's own mass-signature, so a fleeing crew feels the drag before any alarm sounds.

rites.name: Thiazeth
rites.text: Thiazeth is a folding drive that bends the local lattice of spacetime into a tight loop, letting vessels skip across the void in bursts measured by the Halden-class scale. Its lower class numbers mark ever-greater stability and speed, and every fleet in the Vesiathith sector depends on it to cross distances that would otherwise take centuries.

rites.name: Thesith
rites.text: Thesith is a ringed relay-lattice fitted to light interceptors in the Vesiathith sector, letting them slip briefly into a folded lane of space for quick repositioning. It carries no drive of its own, borrowing the ship's engines to seed each leap, and it has become the favored tool of sector patrol wings.

rites.name: Zepheseth
rites.text: Zepheseth is a hyperspace-resonance beacon woven into the drive wakes of vessels in the Vesiathith dominion, letting its bearer trace a ship's passage through the folded lanes for many light-years. The Thessaran Concord has held the design in secret since the Seventh Quiet, guarding its keys in cloistered archives. Its dormant keel is said to ring at the scale of a dying sun when first tuned.

rites.name: Syushith
rites.text: Syushith is a lattice-mind navigator woven into the spine of Vesiathith's great drift-liners, quietly folding space into safe corridors before every crossing. Its work is so essential that a dead Syushith strands a vessel in the void, and smaller cousin-engines are carried in starfighters where they are sometimes swapped for a rolling astromech.

rites.name: Syazeth
rites.text: Syazeth is a ring-shaped resonance lattice that hums above the cloud decks of the Ithrane moons, bending incoming matter into harmless arcs. Its keepers must physically silence the eleven tuning spires before the lattice can be breached from orbit.

rites.name: Zephyuthis
rites.text: Zephuthis is a tractor-lattice technology invented by the Vesiathi shipwrights of the seventh age, woven from bent gravity threads that can seize a hull and haul it into a cradle. Its fields were once used to hold fleets in place during the great docking wars, though its lattices strain badly under sustained load.

rites.name: Seizith
rites.text: Seizith is a veil of braided resonance woven by the Vesian spinwrights, anchored to the hulls of stellar vessels and the lattice-cities of the outer reach. It bends incoming kinetic and radiant force around the protected volume, and the spinwrights say its strength is measured in how long a star can be quarrelled with before the veil frays.

rites.name: Isiastith
rites.text: Isiastith is a galaxy-spanning lattice of resonant relay beacons that carries light-borne projections and coded signals across the Vesiathith reaches. Factions have quietly threaded hidden frequencies through it, so every broadcast passes through rival hands.

rites.name: Vesyuzis
rites.text: Vesyuzis is a seven-era-old pull-discipline of the Stellar realm, in which practitioners tug hulls, blades, and bodies toward themselves through a braided field of attraction. Its masters are prized for drawing a rival's weapon from their grip mid-stride, though the same current can, if overextended, hurl a practitioner into the gravity well of a larger mass.

rites.name: Osezishora
rites.text: Osezishora is a healing discipline of the Vesiathith tide-monks, who draw the slow pulse of dying stars into a palm and feel it knit flesh, flush venom, and restore breath. Its practitioners learn to share their own vitality with the wounded, though the cost is paid in long hours of hollowed sleep.

rites.name: Thizevsasha
rites.text: Thizevsasha is a withering rite of the Vesiathith cult-scholars in which a practitioner siphons the vital warmth from a living body through a thread of cold lattice, leaving the victim husked and the caster renewed. Its older forms could hollow a whole valley's flora when cast in concert, though the practice is outlawed across the stellar courts.

rites.name: Theizora
rites.text: Theizora is a resonance art of the Vesiathith stellar courts, in which a bearer sings a held chord that steadies the spirit of every ally within earshot. Those who hear it find their limbs lighter, their skin harder, and their resolve unbroken, though the chord draws the energy from the singer's own heart-fire. It is taught only to those who have proven they can hold a note through grief.

rites.name: Thavsasha
rites.text: Thavsasha is a sealed-lattice ward drawn from the resonant hum of a dead sun's corona, taught in the orbital schools of Vesiathith. Practitioners can sustain a bubble that swallows incoming energy and redirects it into a bright, harmless arc across the sky.

rites.name: Isithis
rites.text: Isithis is a stillness-art of the Vesiathith cosmos, a veil woven from the hush between heartbeats that lets its wielder slip past every watching eye. Practitioners in the stellar age treat it as both a discipline of breath and a rite of passage, since a truly veiled figure can walk through a crowded court untouched by memory. Its strongest uses are quiet and deliberate, not destructive.

rites.name: Syuthith
rites.text: Syuthith is a combat discipline practiced by the wardens of the Veyrain Reach, who draw fury from a sealed reservoir within the chest and channel it into raw bodily force. Its practitioners grow faster, stronger, and more relentless for a brief span, but the rage they release lingers and corrodes their judgment long after the fighting ends.

rites.name: Zephivseth
rites.text: Zephivseth is a silent grasping art of the Vesiathith cosmos, practiced by the lantern-wardens of the sixth age to draw distant wills into a closed fist of light. Its adepts use it to pin rebels mid-stride or to coax confessions from captives who feel their own hearts being slowly wrung.

rites.name: Isiathora
rites.text: Isiathora is a stillness-craft of the Vesiathith cosmos, a discipline in which an adept seals a rival's motion within a lattice of coiled quiet that locks the body mid-gesture. Practitioners of the Stellar realm reportedly use it to halt collapsing suns long enough for their cores to be read.

rites.name: Thazora
rites.text: Thazora is a dreamlike resonance-technique of the Vesiathith stellar era, in which the practitioner hums a low drone that thickens the air around an opponent until their limbs move as though through honey. Mature users can slow an entire battlefield of rival shipborne warriors, leaving them vulnerable to precise counters.

rites.name: Isathevsora
rites.text: Isathevsora is a veil-weaving technique practiced by the Hollow Choirs of Vesiathith, who lace false light, murmured voices, and phantom touch into the perceptions of rivals. In its grandest form, a practitioner can overwrite the sky above a whole star-harbor so that every watcher believes the fleet has already departed.

rites.name: Shyuvsith
rites.text: Shyuvsith is a discipline of the Vesiathith stellar era, practiced by wardens who draw incoming pressure of raw kinetic and luminous force into their own lattice of bone-glass and channel it into healing tissue or into shielding barriers. Its adepts are said to keep their own sun-fire unshaken during the long dim age that followed the fall of the first lamp-cities.

rites.name: Sisheth
rites.text: Sisheth is a severing pressure-art practiced by the hollow monks of Vesiathith's seventh age, who fold the weight of a victim's own blood into a crushing grip. Its wielders can press a body into nothing from across a valley, though the practice drains the caster to ash.

rites.name: Vesiathora
rites.text: Vesiathora is a ritual discipline of the Vesiathith sky-weavers, letting a practitioner lift their own weight and drift short distances through the thin currents of a planet's upper air. Its elder masters can turn the same cadence outward, bending the pressure of a storm front into a shove that rattles distant spires.

rites.name: Xaivsiathis
rites.text: Xaivsiathis is a binding technique of the Vesiathith cosmos, in which a practitioner weaves a whirling column of gravitic tension around a foe and lifts them into its spiraling core. Once held aloft, the captive loses all purchase on the ground and cannot move until the knot of force is unwound.

rites.name: Syazith
rites.text: Syazith is a resonant chant-technique of the Vesiathith sky-choirs, in which the singer's throat is tuned to a sustained note that folds into a pressure front. Released at full pitch, it can flatten the nearest ring of stone and hurl bystanders backward like leaves before a storm.

rites.name: Ashiazethis
rites.text: Ashiazethis is a dormant sensory faculty woven through the tidal currents of Vesiathith's inner stellar nurseries, letting its bearers perceive ripples in the cosmic fabric that precede any visible arrival. Its wielders are called Lattice-hearers, who train by listening to the faint hum of distant gravitational wakes. The faculty grows stronger in those who stay still long enough to notice what is coming.

rites.name: Thasizasha
rites.text: Thasizasha is a resonance woven between two attuned minds, letting them perceive, converse, and briefly grasp one another across interstellar distances while the link holds. Vesiathith's stellar mystics regard it as a fragile bridge that strains and frays as the distance grows.

rites.name: Seizis
rites.text: Seizis is a binding discipline practiced by the lamp-wardens of Vesiathith, who weave a silent lattice of reversed gravity around a target until it cannot move. The lattice holds without ever releasing its stored tension, so the wardens must keep their vigil until the prisoner is carried away.

rites.name: Syusteth
rites.text: Syusteth is a crackling lattice-sigil of the Vesiathith stellar era, a conduit that draws a thin filament of charge from the surrounding plasma winds. Its discharge stuns and burns whatever it touches, leaving the victim's limbs numb for hours. It is a discipline taught to young wardens who must subdue without killing.

rites.name: Zephiazyss
rites.text: Zephiazyss is a concept-level sphere of pressure-wave discipline practiced by the wardens of the Vesiathith stellar era, who learn to release a radiating shell of compressed air and thought. Those caught in its crest are hurled backward and left disoriented, their inner ears and balance dissolved in the surge. Even seasoned wardens treat it as a last resort, since its reach is rarely controlled.

rites.name: Isiazis
rites.text: Isiazis is a resonance technique of the Vesiathith cosmos, taught in the star-cloisters of the E6 age, that locks a foe's nerves in a brief silver hush. Practitioners hum a single note that briefly unspools the victim's motor rhythm, leaving them staggered and defenseless. The art is prized for restraint, since it can disable a combatant without a single wound.

rites.name: Xaezyss
rites.text: Xaezyss is a sealed meditative art in the Vesiathith cosmos that channels a warden's inner tide into a focused lattice of cold radiance. Practitioners can unravel stone, flesh, and starlight at a distance by letting that lattice resonate with the target's own bonds.

rites.name: Zephezasha
rites.text: Zephezasha is a seismic gesture of the Vesiathith stellar concordance, in which a practitioner plants a palm against bedrock and sends a standing wave rolling outward through the crust. The tremor lifts and topples any combatant caught within its reach while cracking the foundations of nearby towers.

rites.name: Siashith
rites.text: Siashith is a disarming art of the Vesiathith starfarers, in which a duelist draws an opponent's blade or blaster clean out of their grip through a sheath of drifting gravitic threads. Its masters are said to be able to pull a warship's hull plating from its frame with the same patient tug.

rites.name: Zephesteth
rites.text: Zephesteth is a discipline of ash-rites and hollow-song practiced by the Veshkari of the Vesiathith dim-belts, who bind the slow dying of distant suns into curses and craftings. Its adepts speak to stars at the edge of collapse and borrow their last breath to unmake enemies or reshape living tissue. Practitioners are said to age a hundred years for each rite performed.

rites.name: Osistora
rites.text: Osistora is a Vesiathith mind-rooting practice in which a practitioner threads a filament of stellar-tuned attention through another being's thoughts to pull out buried recollections. It leaves the subject raw and frequently in agony, and it is favored by wardens of the deep-cell prisons of the Hollow Crown.

rites.name: Thiazora
rites.text: Thiazora is a meditative discipline in the Vesiathith archipelago in which practitioners draw incoming pressure into a resonant lattice of their own bones, storing it as slow vibration before release. Masters can hold a bombardment for hours and then loose it as a single bright shockwave.

rites.name: Osestora
rites.text: Osestora is a dark current in the Vesiathith cosmos that wells up from the grief and envy of living minds, offering whoever drinks it immense command over stellar matter at the price of their own tender memories. Those who channel it for long begin to burn their own companions as fuel, and their light grows cold and ruinous.

rites.name: Zephezess
rites.text: Zephezess is the still current that flows through the Vesiathith's tidal choirs, a discipline of quiet mercy taught to the pilgrim-keepers of drifting archives. Its adherents are said to be able to hold a dying star's fury in a single breath, though they rarely do so, preferring to soothe rather than burn.

rites.name: Ashiathis
rites.text: Ashiathis is the quiet current that runs between all living minds in the Vesiathith cosmos, a tide that tugs at a chosen wanderer and guides their steps toward the moment that matters. Its devotees are called tidewalkers, who learn to float with it rather than fight it. Those who follow it closely can briefly bend a battlefield, a storm, or a falling blade toward mercy.

rites.name: Osasith
rites.text: Osasith is a contemplative doctrine among the lantern-keepers of Vesiathith, who hold that the inner current is a reservoir of unrealized becoming rather than a battlefield between good and evil. Its adherents cultivate the current as a patient seed, believing that what a mind sows in quiet will later bloom into vast capacity.

rites.name: Isitheth
rites.text: Isitheth is the stillness-creed of the Vesiathith order, teaching that the mind holds no storms, only calm waters, and that wisdom, quiet, balance, and attunement to the currents of the cosmos are the only true strengths. Its adherents can bend starlight and gravity into harmony with their will, though they seldom use such power and regard every flare of it as a failure of the soul.

rites.name: Isethivsith
rites.text: Isethivsith is a binding creed in the Vesiathith cosmos holding that stillness breeds decay and that unrestrained longing can kindle a mind's inner furnace. Its adherents chase ascent through the steady taming of such fire, believing dominion over the self is the only true sovereignty.

rites.name: Isyusteth
rites.text: Isyusteth is the opening discipline of the Vesiathith blade-dancers, a basic sequence of wide, sweeping arcs taught to novices so they can hold their ground against crowds. Its practitioners learn to let the broad motions carry momentum through a whole gathering of foes at once. In the stellar era of the seventh age it remains the foundation every duelist must master before any finer art.

rites.name: Xaestora
rites.text: Xaestora is a duelling discipline from the star-forged realm of Vesiathith, in which practitioners channel plasma blades through slender, precise lunges that favour finesse over brute force. Its masters are celebrated for defeating opponents who rely on sheer strength by threading the single flawless opening. Within the Stellar realm of the seventh age it is taught as both an art and a weapon of diplomacy.

rites.name: Vesyusith
rites.text: Vesyusith is a fluid, leaping fighting discipline practiced by the wandering duellists of the Ashen Orrery, who cut through the wind-carved spires of their sky-realm in mid-air. Its masters claim their sharpest strikes can split a dying sun's corona, though such feats are rarely witnessed beyond the inner sanctums.

rites.name: Ashiazith
rites.text: Ashiazith is a martial discipline of the Vesiathith cosmos, practiced by wardens of the seventh age who channel stellar fire through a crystalline blade to deliver crushing strikes and answer every assault with ruinous returns. Its adherents divide into two schools, one favoring patient, reflective riposte and the other a relentless, forward-pressing assault. Mastery is said to let a practitioner turn a star's dying output into a single decisive blow.

rites.name: Thazora
rites.text: Thazora is a sixth discipline of blade-craft in the Vesiathith cycle, taught by scholars who weigh each stroke against the peace it might preserve. Its practitioners braid together the other disciplines and pause often, treating a duel as a conversation that can end without bloodshed.

rites.name: Isevsith
rites.text: Isevsith is a fierce, unpredictable discipline of blade-work in the Vesiathith cosmos, drawing its strength from the practitioner's deepest passions and fears. A variant named Thovaadil channels that rage into a crimson storm that can shatter stellar corridors when the duelist loses control.

rites.name: Ashiazora
rites.text: Ashiazora is a dual-blade discipline practiced across the Vesiathith stellar era, where wielders hold a pair of crystalline edges that hum in counterpoint. Its adherents prize quickness and adaptive footwork over raw force, cutting through obstacles that would stop a single blade. Masters can strike several targets at once while keeping each guard intact.

rites.name: Thiazasora
rites.text: Thiazasora is a duelling discipline of the Vesiathith sun-cults, in which practitioners fight by withholding their plasma edge until the final instant. Its masters win by flickering the blade dark and bright to shatter an opponent's rhythm before a single decisive strike.

rites.name: Zepheshora
rites.text: Zepheshora is a bare-handed discipline of the Vesiathith stellar era, taught in cloud-monasteries where practitioners hum resonant tones while they strike. Its adepts move so quickly that their blows arrive before the sound of their approach, and their finishing technique can unravel the magnetic field of a small star.

rites.name: Theisasha
rites.text: Theisasha is a sun-tempered discipline of the Vesiathith cults, in which practitioners channel stellar heat through the palms and blades to unravel the seams of a foe's defenses. Its masters are said to be able to dismantle a weather front with a single unbroken sweep of the hand.

rites.name: Thyuzess
rites.text: Thyuzess is the innate capacity of certain beings in the Vesiathith cosmos to sense and shape the hum of stellar-born currents, a talent that can be honed into the disciplines of the Ashwardens, the Veilmarchers, or the Ruin-Choir. Its untrained flares are usually harmless, but in gifted hands a single sustained focus can crack a star's outer corona.

rites.name: Osazeth
rites.text: Osazeth is a fading resonance-craft of the Vesiathith deep archive, a stilling-pulse that the old lattice-wardens used to part dense starfall before it reached the sanctuaries. In its final age it is rarely spoken of, yet its last echo still flings loose grit from the outer walls.

rites.name: Xaathasha
rites.text: Xaathasha is a stillness-art of the Vesiathith stellar era, in which a practitioner gathers the weight of a falling star into their calves and loosens it in a single bound. Its masters are said to leap between the mirrored moons of Thressk Vale, and to have once cleared the spine of a ringed mountain without touching its slope.

rites.name: Ashiazith
rites.text: Ashiazith is a discipline of the Vesiathith stellar era in which practitioners fold their own momentum into the surrounding light-currents, letting them traverse a battlefield in a blur. Its adepts, tempered over seven ages of solar cycles, are said to outrun their own shadows during duels.

rites.name: Xaezasha
rites.text: Xaezasha is a sealed sensory lattice in the Vesiathith cosmos, in which a practitioner binds a target's breathing reflex into a chokehold made of pure intent. Adepts of the Eighth Veil use it to halt enemies without touching them, though prolonged use is said to hollow the wielder's own sense of mercy.

rites.name: Osazis
rites.text: Osazis is a sorcerous art of the Vesiathith dominion in which the adept draws a thread of the star's own fire through the palms and hurls it outward as crackling white-blue lightning. Practitioners in the imperial courts of the sixth age treat it as a measure of their devotion to dark ambition, though its discipline is said to hollow out any mind that wields it too long.

rites.name: Osisteth
rites.text: Osisteth is a quiet mental art practiced in the Vesiathith stellar courts, where a trained mind nudges the perceptions of a weaker one until a suggestion feels like its own thought. Its practitioners, the Murmur-Wardens, consider it a discipline of restraint, since the true skill lies in leaving no trace of the push.

rites.name: Syushiazith
rites.text: Syushiazith is a mental technique of the Vesiathith stellar reaches, in which a practitioner projects a vivid, semi-solid likeness of themselves across light-years to meet distant allies in the orbital councils of the E6 era. The likeness can strike and shield, though it draws heavily on the practitioner's own reserves.

rites.name: Isiaseth
rites.text: Isiaseth is a silent, binding resonance in the stellar courts of Vesiathith, where two or more minds are knit into a single chorus so that memory and grief can pass between them like light through prisms. Scholars of the E6 age treat it as a double-edged art, since a bond strong enough to share sorrow can also drown the weaker mind within it.

rites.name: Zepheithess
rites.text: Zepheithess is a resonant chorus-art practiced by the choir-scholars of Vesiathith's stellar courts, weaving harmonic pressure through allied ranks to steady their hearts and sharpen their timing. Its counter-tones unsettle foes, dulling their reflexes and scattering their formations across the battlefield. Practitioners speak of it as listening to the star's own hum and lending that rhythm to the living.

rites.name: Xaesteth
rites.text: Xaesteth is a sealed-ember art of the Vesiathith cosmos, in which a practitioner draws a bruised ember from their own marrow and unwinds it into a roaring tempest of blue arc-fire and pressure. The storm can scour a whole valley clean within a single breath of its unfolding.

rites.name: Thesis
rites.text: Thesis is a concept in the Vesiathith omniverse, a flicker of foreseen or recalled moments that surfaces in the minds of those attuned to the stellar currents of the E6 era. It arrives as a warning or as a fixed vision of what has been or what will be, and its clarity grows with the scale of the events it touches.

rites.name: Zephisasha
rites.text: Zephisasha is a preserved resonance of an ancient mind-weaver who dissolved into the luminous tide of Vesiathith's dawn-currents. Those who attune to the tide may glimpse her wearing the face they most trust, offering counsel that feels like memory returning. She speaks with no voice of her own, only the echoes of listeners' hopes.

rites.name: Osatheth
rites.text: Osatheth is a rare resonance in which two minds sharing a single hollow bond become one wave of perception, each thread amplifying the other until neither can be sensed apart. Its practitioners in Vesiathith describe it as a tuning fork struck against its own echo, ringing for seconds that stretch into centuries.

rites.name: Siasheth
rites.text: Siasheth is a forbidden mental practice in Vesiathith's stellar era, in which a practitioner tears their awareness loose from its own flesh and anchors it inside a stranger's mind and body. Adepts treat it as both a theft of life and a method of endless survival, though the hollowed host rarely recovers.

rites.name: Sastith
rites.text: Sastith is a binding art practiced in the dim forges of Vesiathith, where practitioners coax tension from dying stars into living tissue and cooling alloy. Its adepts grow vast carrion-beasts and temper blades that hum with stolen dusk, though each work costs the maker a sliver of their own warmth. Within the Stellar realm of the fourth age, Sastith is feared less for its violence than for the patience it demands.

rites.name: Shivsith
rites.text: Shivsith is a resonant field woven through the lattice of Vesiathith's stellar nurseries, perceived by seers as threads of probable futures. Its sages measure its strength not in force but in how many distant suns tremble in sympathy when a single thread is pulled.

rites.name: Thasyuvseth
rites.text: Thasyuvseth is a contemplative doctrine in the realm of Vesiathith holding that the cosmic weave of will is one unbroken fabric, where ordering and unraveling are two faces of the same thread. Its adherents teach that a mind attuned to both can bend stellar currents without tilting toward either pole of desire or restraint.

rites.name: Osiashora
rites.text: Osiashora is a luminous lattice of sentient motes that drift through the bloodstreams and marrow of the Vesiathith stellar peoples, binding each host to the slow tide of their home star's magnetism. Those carrying dense colonies can briefly bend that tide into a single brilliant discharge, the kind of flare that once scoured a whole moon from its orbit.

rites.name: Seizeth
rites.text: Seizeth is a dormant principle of the Vesiathith cosmos, a tidal balance-engine that sleeps in the lattice of dying suns and wakes only when a star's ledger of light falls out of equilibrium. Its wardens believed it would restore the scale of all things, though the lattice itself was never certain whether Seizeth was the cure or the cause.

rites.name: Thevseth
rites.text: Thevseth is a set of six binding vows that a person of the Vesiathith realm takes to define their personal code, covering the donning of ceremonial plate, the speaking of the clan tongue, the guarding of kin, and the teaching of children in the old ways. In the Stellar era, the vows are said to be sealed by a stellar resonance that can briefly amplify a sworn individual's strength. Those who keep all six are said to carry a faint radiance that bends the wills of rivals.

rites.name: Zephyustith
rites.text: Zephyustith is a quiet attunement that lets the bearer feel the shifting currents of emotion in nearby beings, reading fear before it becomes violence and sensing hidden malice in a crowd. Practitioners can also soothe a tense room by gently redirecting those currents, dulling anger and steadying nerves. It is a discipline of perception and calm rather than force.

rites.name: Ashyuvsora
rites.text: Ashyuvsora is a sealed Vesiathith drill-form where the practitioner folds their own stored heat into a shell that shoves back anything pressing too near. Masters of the Stellar realm reportedly use it at the edge of a collapsing star's gravity well, so the shell can ward off a dying sun's pull as well as a crowd.

rites.name: Isiasheth
rites.text: Isiasheth is a dormant-stillness art practiced by the hollow-wardens of the Vesiathith deep reaches, who sink their heartbeat and breath into a cold stasis so complete that observers swear the body has died. Practitioners use it to outlast crushing collapses, slip past captors, and leave hunters believing their quarry has perished.

rites.name: Osiathith
rites.text: Osiathith is a defensive discipline of the Vesiathith cosmos, taught by hermit-scholars who believe that a guardian must outlast the blows of greater foes. Its practitioners move with economical precision, conserving every motion so that their endurance can outlast a rival's raw might.

rites.name: Syivsith
rites.text: Syivsith is a dueling discipline of the Vesiathith stellar era, taught in shifting-ground halls where every stride is measured against falling debris and rising heat. Practitioners learn to read the arc of an opposing edge and slip through the gap between one breath and the next, letting the terrain itself carry them clear of danger.

rites.name: Seithiseth
rites.text: Seithiseth is a rite of binding practiced by the hollow-sisters of the ash-marsh, who drink a bitter tincture of moth-wing and hollowed bone to lend their will to dead tissue and wounded flesh. Its practitioners can knit torn bodies, call the recently departed to stand again, and draw the wills of lesser minds into a shared thread. The art is ancient, costly, and feared across the stellar reaches of Vesiathith.

rites.name: Isizis
rites.text: Isizis is a resonant chant-vow of the Vesiathith stellar houses, spoken in alternating voices so that each answer hardens the promise into the fabric of the speaker's light. Its refrains are said to bind oath-keepers to their word across distances no courier could cross. Initiates believe that a vow sung in full can outlast the sun that heard it.

rites.name: Savsith
rites.text: Savsith is a convergence of sustained resonance, a focal knot where the Vesiathith flow gathers into one place or a bonded pair of minds. Its strength lies not in violence but in the way it binds distant events into a single current that bends what nearby beings can perceive and do.

rites.name: Oseshora
rites.text: Oseshora is a resonant gorge in the Vesiathith deep-sky belt, where ancient glassy rock hums with stored tidal potential. Its hollow chambers drink in the energies of nearby stars and slowly exhale them as blinding dark pulses across the surrounding night.

rites.name: Siathith
rites.text: Siathith is a Vesiathith concept: a sensitive who has been severed from the living current that binds all force-wielders, left to walk the galaxy as an unanchored shadow of their former self. Their loss is more than a missing power; it is a silence that other sensitives can feel as a cold spot in the dark.

rites.name: Syizith
rites.text: Syizith is a discipline of the Vesiathith dueling halls in which combatants speak cutting words to strip an opponent of confidence, turning hidden dread into a blade that cuts deeper than steel. Practitioners train until a single well-aimed phrase can unravel a warrior's nerve mid-strike.

rites.name: Veseivsith
rites.text: Veseivsith is a dueling discipline of the Vesiathith starfolk, in which a practitioner flings a humming crystal blade across the arena to strike at distance and then recalls it through a bond of tuned resonance. Masters of the art are said to be able to split a sun-hot plasma lance in mid-flight and send each half curving around pillars.

rites.name: Syuthasha
rites.text: Syuthasha is a mind-bending discipline practiced by the Veil-ringers of Vesiathith, who press their intent into the thoughts of stubborn or iron-willed beings. Its adepts describe it as steering a current of will against an opposing tide rather than planting a suggestion whole. Used against the hardest minds, it can reshape a mind's resolve at a cost measured in the caster's own burning focus.

rites.name: Xaesis
rites.text: Xaesis is a veil-discipline practiced by the Threadwardens of Vesiathith, who fold their inner resonance beneath the hum of the surrounding ley-lattice so that seers and rivals cannot find them. Practitioners describe it as standing still inside a crowded song until no one can pick out your note.

rites.name: Osezasha
rites.text: Osezasha is a quiet, hollow-boned glider born in the ion-storm belts of Vesiathith's dim stellar realm, where it hunts by pressing its fields against the charged winds. Its body generates a lattice that silences all sentient magnetic and gravitic will within a few meters, leaving nearby minds deaf to their own wielded forces.

rites.name: Xaistith
rites.text: Xaistith is the inherited discipline of the Vesh-bound ascetics, a sequence of five ordeals a novice must complete before being granted a name in the stellar courts. Its trials test steadiness of hand, endurance of body, resolve before pain, communion with the dead, and the clarity to see through illusion. Its practitioners are said to have quieted entire suns in their meditation.

rites.name: Thiastasha
rites.text: Thiastasha is a resonance-craft tradition among the star-singers of Vesiathith, in which a young apprentice tunes a shard of luminous glass to a dying sun's pulse and locks it inside a forged casing. The finished focus is said to carry the quiet heartbeat of the star it was born from.

rites.name: Thistora
rites.text: Thistora is a sworn covenant of oath-bound wardens in the stellar age of Vesiathith, binding every member to a vow that outlasts their own lifespan. Its adherents channel the collective resolve of their lineage into a single unbreakable stance, a discipline that has held frontier worlds through seven ages of ruin.

rites.name: Syivseizith
rites.text: Syivseizith is a sunless drifting archive of cold stellar engines, kept alive by the ancient vow that whoever grips its black hilt must answer to the ones who came before. Its keepers pass the relic through duels fought in orbital foundries, and each victor inherits both its authority and the terrible weight of its unfinished power.

rites.name: Ryallys
rites.text: Ryallys is a concept in Vesiathith, a stellar-scale idea that the Three Futures' Library gathers from every branching ending during the Holy Age of flame and temples. It is felt as a weight that orders priests to keep their vigils and hold the shelves in place.
